daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — all point the same direction at once. A single bullish signal can be noise, but when four or five line up together, it suggests real conviction behind the move, not just a random blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重信號確認是指只有當多個獨立的技術指標——例如RSI、MACD、均線及成交量——同時指向同一方向時,才採取交易行動。單一的看漲信號可能只是雜訊,但當四至五個指標同時吻合時,便顯示這波走勢背後有真正的動能支持,而非偶然波動。

market_education.summary_en: Today's session was largely directionless, with the NASDAQ roughly flat and the S&P500 up a modest 0.3%, suggesting investors were in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any major catalyst. Without a clear macro trigger, individual stock-level technicals — like volume surges and MACD crossovers — became the more reliable signal for finding opportunities. This favors a selective, bottom-up approach over broad index-wide moves on days like this.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市方向不明,納指幾乎持平,標普500僅微升0.3%,反映投資者普遍採取觀望態度,未有明顯催化劑帶動大盤走勢。在缺乏宏觀主線的情況下,個股層面的技術信號(例如成交量放大、MACD黃金交叉)反而成為尋找機會更可靠的依據。這類市況下,精選個股的策略通常比追逐大盤走勢更為合適。
